name: Morax
source:
Morax converts the injuries of other devils into his pain to heal other devils. Therefore, when the battle ends, he is always the most injured, except for the dead devils.

There are rumors that he looks like a handsome boy who gives you heartsores under his bandages, at the same time as the rumors that he looks like a terrifying monster that gives you nightmares.

Morax is Lucifer's most trusted general.
